$comment: Import v2's static breakdown: atomic-codemod's JS -> atoms transform and its checked converter (convert, then run old and new in QuickJS on generated inputs; a rewrite counts only when both behave the same), linked from its own git repo like atomic-codemod.json (no source copy). Branch atoms-transform lives beside the to-english pin, so it has its own table. The folder is $ATOMS_CODEMOD_SOURCE_DIR, else `default`. `commit` pins its HEAD; bump it by hand after checking the change (link.mjs --pin covers links.json only).

@smith/atoms-transform.what: atomic-codemod's toAtoms: JS -> atom calls, untranslated parts listed

@smith/atoms-checked.what: atomic-codemod's checked converter: convert, check in QuickJS, take back what changes behaviour

@smith/atoms-runtime.what: the atom runtime's committed snapshot, catalog and QuickJS bundle

@smith/atoms-equivalence.what: the types a file declares, as value descriptors for generated inputs

@smith/atoms-checker-types.what: parameter types from the TypeScript checker, for parameters typed only by their context
